title: FAISS Semantic Cache for LLMs
subtitle: High-Speed Local Vector Semantic Cache PoC
summary: 100% local semantic cache in Python. Generates embeddings using Ollama and performs in-memory similarity search with FAISS and NumPy.
overview: Proof of Concept (PoC) demonstrating a high-performance local vector semantic cache designed to intercept user prompts, search FAISS index for semantically equivalent cached responses, and eliminate expensive redundant LLM API calls.
responsibilities: Integrated Ollama locally for generating dense vector embeddings from user prompts.
Built FAISS IndexFlatL2 in-memory vector similarity search engine.
Implemented distance thresholding logic using NumPy cosine similarity metrics.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Reducing LLM token costs and latency for repetitive queries.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Local FAISS vector cache returning responses instantly when prompt distance satisfies similarity threshold.

metrics: 100% local execution with zero cloud dependency

owaspMitigations.title: Cryptographic Failures & Data Privacy
owaspMitigations.description: Embeddings (Ollama) and vector search (FAISS) processed 100% locally in-memory, preventing sensitive data exposure to third-party cloud LLMs.

owaspMitigations.title: Insecure Design (Zero-Trust AI)
owaspMitigations.description: Execution adhering to Zero-Trust AI principles in isolated runtimes with strict semantic threshold validation.
